description: Comprehensive Government Concessional Credit, Subvention & Subsidy Schemes Dataset for Rural and Semi-Urban Micro-Entrepreneurs

schemes.implementing_agency: State Channelizing Agencies (SCAs) / NBFC-MFIs / Scheduled Banks
criteria: Total annual household income must not exceed ₹3,00,000
Age limit: 18 - 60 years
Loans provided to individuals or through Joint Liability Groups (JLGs) and Self Help Groups (SHGs)
Zero physical collateral required
schemes.minimum_project_price: No legal minimum floor set by RBI
schemes.maximum_loan_limit: Individual: up to ₹2.00 Lakh (Concessional SCA cap: ₹1.25 Lakh - ₹1.40 Lakh); Large MFIs/NBFC-MFIs: up to ₹1,000 Crore credit line
schemes.interest_rate: 6.5% p.a. (under Government Concessional SCA window); Market MFI rate: 16% - 26% p.a.
schemes.moratorium_period: 3 months repayment holiday directly after disbursement
schemes.max_tenure: Small loans (under ₹25,000): 12 - 18 months; Loans above ₹30,000: 24 - 36 months (up to 3 years)
documents_required: KYC documents (Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, PAN Card)
Photographs of borrower and co-borrower / guarantor
Ration card or local income certificate

schemes.scheme_name: Term Loan Scheme (Concessional SCA & MSME Window)
schemes.implementing_agency: Apex Corporations (NSFDC / NMDFC / NBCFDC) & Partner Commercial Banks
criteria: Business must display consistent profitability for at least 2 consecutive financial years (for existing units)
CIBIL credit score of 700 or above preferred
Age limit: 21 - 65 years
Eligible entities: Sole proprietorships, partnership firms, private limited companies, LLPs
schemes.minimum_project_price: Depends on lending bank / Apex Corporation (typically starts from ₹1.40 Lakh)
schemes.maximum_loan_limit: NMDFC: up to ₹30 Lakh; NSFDC: up to ₹45 Lakh; PMMY Tarun: up to ₹20 Lakh; Commercial Bank MSME term loan: up to ₹20 Crore
schemes.interest_rate: 8.0% p.a. (Apex Concessional Window); Commercial MSME rate: 9% - 13% depending on credit rating
schemes.moratorium_period: 3 to 12 months (typically 6 months for agro-processing and manufacturing units)
schemes.max_tenure: 3 to 7 years (up to 10 years for agro-processing; up to 25 years for large fixed infrastructure)
documents_required: Audited balance sheets and P&L statements for last 2-3 years
ITR and GST returns for past 1-2 years
Business proof: Udyam registration, partnership deed, MOA/AOA, trade license
Detailed Project Report (DPR) with machinery quotations

schemes.implementing_agency: National Minorities / Backward Classes / SC Corporations via State SCAs
criteria: Applicant must be a woman
Age limit: 18 to 55 years
Target category: Backward Classes (OBC), SC, ST, or Below Poverty Line (BPL)
Self-employment intent: Must use loan to start or expand a micro-enterprise
schemes.maximum_loan_limit: Individual beneficiary: up to ₹1,25,000; SHGs / Group loans: up to ₹15,00,000
documents_required: Address proof (Electricity bill, Ration card, Residence certificate)
Income certificate issued by competent revenue authority

schemes.implementing_agency: Ministry of Rural Development (DAY-NRLM) / State Rural Livelihoods Missions (OLM in Odisha)
criteria: Must be a rural woman farmer
Must be an active member of a registered Self-Help Group (SHG)
Both land-owning farmers and landless agricultural wage laborers are eligible
Age: 18 years or older
Statutory reservation: ST (15%), SC (25%)
schemes.maximum_loan_limit: Individual woman farmer: up to ₹3,00,000; SHG Federation: up to ₹10,00,000
schemes.margin_money_percent: Nil or nominal SHG group corpus contribution
schemes.interest_rate: Standard concessional rate: 7% p.a.; Prompt repayment subvention: 4% p.a.; Special Odisha State Subvention (Mission Shakti): 0% p.a.
schemes.moratorium_period: Internal SHG loans: up to 6 months; Large individual enterprise loans: up to 18 months; Crop failure relief: 1-2 years
documents_required: SHG membership resolution and passbook copy

schemes.implementing_agency: State Scheduled Castes Finance & Development Corporation (OSFDC in Odisha)
criteria: Caste: Must belong to Scheduled Caste (SC) community
No ceiling on family annual income
Age limit: 18 to 60 years
Loan must be utilized for income-generating micro-business activities
schemes.maximum_loan_limit: Up to ₹1,25,000 (with remaining ₹15,000 as promoter contribution / margin money)
documents_required: Caste certificate issued by Tehsildar / Sub-Collector
Age proof (School certificate or Birth certificate)

schemes.implementing_agency: National Safai Karamcharis Finance & Development Corporation (NSKFDC)
criteria: Applicant must be a Safai Karamchari (cleaning/sanitation worker or manual scavenger)
Only women are eligible (including dependent daughters of Safai Karamcharis)
Age: 18 years old or above
Must be a citizen of India and utilize funds for small business or trade
schemes.interest_rate: 1.0% to 4.0% per annum (Lowest tier concessional lending)
documents_required: Proof of profession (Safai Karamchari ID card / local municipality certification)
Brief project profile / simple business plan

schemes.implementing_agency: Commercial Banks / RRBs / Small Finance Banks / MFIs
criteria: Target borrowers: Non-Corporate Small Business (NCSB) segment in rural and urban areas
Age limit: 18 to 65 years
Must have a satisfactory repayment record and no existing default
Zero physical collateral and zero third-party guarantee required
schemes.minimum_project_price: No strict floor set by Government
schemes.maximum_loan_limit: Categorized into 4 tiers: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishore (₹50,001 to ₹5,00,000), Tarun (₹5,00,001 to ₹10,00,000), Tarun Plus (₹10,00,001 to ₹20,00,000 for previous Tarun repayers)
schemes.interest_rate: 8.0% to 12.5% p.a. (Determined by lending bank based on risk grade)
schemes.moratorium_period: Shishu: Up to 3 months; Kishore/Tarun: 6 to 12 months
schemes.max_tenure: Loans up to ₹5 Lakh: up to 5 years; Loans up to ₹20 Lakh: up to 7 years
documents_required: Business registration proof (Udyam, GST, Trade license)
Bank account statements for past 6-12 months
Financial statements / ITR (for Kishore and Tarun tiers)

schemes.implementing_agency: All Scheduled Commercial Banks (Mandated 1 SC/ST & 1 Woman per branch)
criteria: Target group: Women entrepreneurs (all categories) and SC/ST entrepreneurs
Age: 18 years or above
Must be a greenfield enterprise (first time venture in manufacturing, services, agri-allied, or trading)
At least 51% shareholding and controlling stake must be held by SC/ST or woman promoter
schemes.margin_money_percent: Up to 15% (can be converged with eligible state capital subsidies to bring promoter margin to 10%)
schemes.interest_rate: Lowest applicable rate for that category: Base Rate (MCLR) + 3% + tenure premium
documents_required: Balance sheets and projected cash flows
Proof of business premises (rent lease / land ownership)

schemes.scheme_name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
schemes.implementing_agency: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA) via Scheduled Banks / NBFCs
criteria: Targets street vendors operating in urban as well as surrounding peri-urban and rural fringe areas
Must be actively engaged in vending
Must possess a Certificate of Vending (CoV) / Identity Card issued by Town Vending Committee (TVC), or a Letter of Recommendation (LoR) approved by ULB/BDO
Age limit: 18 to 60 years
schemes.maximum_loan_limit: 1st Tranche: up to ₹15,000; 2nd Tranche: up to ₹25,000; 3rd Tranche: up to ₹50,000
schemes.interest_rate: Base bank interest rate (9.9% - 15% p.a.) with a direct 7.0% p.a. interest subsidy credited to account + ₹1,200/yr digital cashback
schemes.moratorium_period: Nil (Immediate monthly repayment to build credit discipline)
schemes.max_tenure: 1st Tranche: 12 months; 2nd Tranche: 18 months; 3rd Tranche: 36 months
documents_required: Certificate of Vending (CoV) / Vending ID / BDO Letter of Recommendation
Registered mobile number linked with Aadhaar

schemes.implementing_agency: Ministry of MSME & Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
criteria: Must be an artisan or craftsperson working with hands and tools in one of the 18 recognized traditional trades (Carpenter, Blacksmith, Potter, Mason, Barber, Tailor, Cobbler, etc.)
Minimum age: 18 years
Self-employed in the unorganized / informal sector
Only one member per family is eligible
Must not have availed loans under PMEGP, PM SVANidhi, or MUDRA in the past 5 years
schemes.maximum_loan_limit: 1st Tranche: up to ₹1,00,000; 2nd Tranche: up to ₹2,00,000; Total: up to ₹3,00,000
schemes.interest_rate: Concessional fixed rate of 5.0% per annum (Government pays up to 8% interest subvention to lending bank)
schemes.moratorium_period: As per bank repayment schedule (typically 1 to 3 months)
schemes.max_tenure: 1st Tranche: up to 18 months; 2nd Tranche: up to 30 months
documents_required: Aadhaar Card linked with mobile number
Trade verification by Gram Panchayat Pradhan or Urban Local Body Executive Officer

schemes.scheme_name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) - Crop, Dairy, Poultry & Fisheries
schemes.implementing_agency: NABARD / Commercial Banks / Cooperative Banks / RRBs
criteria: Individual farmers, tenant farmers, oral lessees, sharecroppers
Self Help Groups (SHGs) or Joint Liability Groups (JLGs) of farmers
Farmers involved in agriculture, animal husbandry, dairy cattle rearing, poultry, or fisheries
schemes.maximum_loan_limit: Collateral-free credit limit: up to ₹2,00,000 (elevated from ₹1.60L); Modified Interest Subvention Scheme (MISS) limit: up to ₹5,00,000 (dairy/poultry/crop)
schemes.margin_money_percent: Nil for loans up to ₹2.00 Lakh
schemes.interest_rate: Standard 7% p.a. concessional rate; 3% Prompt Repayment Incentive (Effective cost to farmer: 4.0% p.a.)
schemes.moratorium_period: Linked to crop harvesting / livestock lactation cycle (no rigid monthly moratorium)
schemes.max_tenure: Card valid for 5 years with annual renewal; repayment linked to seasonal marketing cycle
documents_required: Land ownership record (RoR / Patta) or lease agreement / tenancy declaration
Proof of livestock ownership (ear-tag records) for dairy/poultry KCC

schemes.scheme_name: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME)
schemes.implementing_agency: Ministry of Food Processing Industries (MoFPI) & State Nodal Agencies
criteria: Individual micro food processing enterprises (existing units upgrading or new units)
Proprietorship / partnership firms, FPOs, Farmer Producer Companies, Cooperatives, and SHGs
Focus on 'One District One Product' (ODOP) - e.g., Fish/Prawn in Khordha, Turmeric in Kandhamal
Applicant must possess ownership / lease of premises
schemes.maximum_loan_limit: Individual units: Credit-linked capital subsidy of 35% of eligible project cost (Maximum ₹10.00 Lakh); Common infrastructure: 35% subsidy up to ₹3.00 Crore
schemes.interest_rate: Lending bank's prevailing commercial MSME interest rate (effectively cushioned by the 35% upfront capital subsidy)
schemes.moratorium_period: Up to 6 months depending on commercial bank sanction
documents_required: Detailed Project Report (DPR) prepared via District Resource Person (DRP)
Business registration (Udyam / FSSAI license / GST if applicable)
Machinery quotations and factory floor layout

schemes.implementing_agency: Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC) / DIC / KVIB
criteria: Applicant must be 18 years or above
Minimum 8th pass qualification for manufacturing projects costing >₹10 Lakh and service projects >₹5 Lakh
Must set up a new micro-enterprise in the non-farm sector
Special categories: SC, ST, OBC, Women, Minorities, Ex-servicemen, PwD
schemes.maximum_loan_limit: Manufacturing Sector: Maximum project cost up to ₹50.00 Lakh; Service / Business Sector: Maximum project cost up to ₹20.00 Lakh
schemes.margin_money_percent: Beneficiary margin: 10% for General category; 5% for Special Categories (SC/ST/OBC/Women/Rural)
schemes.interest_rate: Normal bank MSME interest rate, offset by substantial non-refundable government margin money subsidy: Urban (15% Gen, 25% Spl); Rural (25% Gen, 35% Spl)
schemes.moratorium_period: Initial moratorium of 6 months as prescribed by the financing bank
documents_required: Rural Area Certificate issued by Gram Panchayat / BDO
Detailed Project Report (DPR) with machine quotes

schemes.implementing_agency: National Backward Classes Finance and Development Corporation (via State SCAs)
criteria: Must belong to an eligible Other Backward Class (OBC) notified by Central or State Government
Annual family income must not exceed ₹3,00,000
Must undertake a viable income-generating micro-enterprise or service activity
Persons with Disabilities (PwDs) receive an additional 0.25% interest concession
schemes.maximum_loan_limit: Individual loans: up to ₹25.00 Lakh (Up to 85% of project cost financed by Corporation)
schemes.margin_money_percent: 15% promoter margin (can be reduced to 10% under special state schemes)
schemes.interest_rate: Up to ₹1.25 Lakh: 7.0% p.a.; From ₹1.25 Lakh to ₹25 Lakh: 8.0% p.a.; 1.0% rebate for timely repayments
schemes.max_tenure: Up to ₹1.25 Lakh: 4 years; ₹1.25 Lakh to ₹25 Lakh: up to 7 years

schemes.scheme_name: NHFDC Concessional Loan Scheme for Divyangjan
schemes.implementing_agency: National Handicapped Finance and Development Corporation via State SCAs & RRBs
criteria: Person with benchmark disability (minimum 40% disability certified by medical authority)
Indian citizen aged 18 years or above
Eligible for setting up self-employment ventures or commercial activities
schemes.maximum_loan_limit: Up to ₹50.00 Lakh per beneficiary / unit
schemes.margin_money_percent: Loans up to ₹5 Lakh: Nil; Loans above ₹5 Lakh: 5% - 10%
schemes.interest_rate: Loans up to ₹50,000: 5.0% p.a.; ₹50,000 to ₹5 Lakh: 6.0% p.a.; ₹5 Lakh to ₹15 Lakh: 7.0% p.a.; ₹15 Lakh to ₹50 Lakh: 8.0% p.a. (Special 1% rebate for women with disabilities)
schemes.moratorium_period: As decided by implementing agency (typically 6 to 12 months for commercial projects)
schemes.max_tenure: Up to 10 years depending on the activity
documents_required: Unique Disability ID (UDID) Card / Medical Disability Certificate (>=40%)

schemes.scheme_name: NMDFC Concessional Term Loan (Credit Line 1 & Credit Line 2)
schemes.implementing_agency: National Minorities Development & Finance Corporation via State SCAs
criteria: Must belong to a notified National Minority community (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi)
Credit Line 1: Annual family income up to ₹3,00,000 (Targeted concessional segment)
Credit Line 2: Annual family income up to ₹8,00,000 (Extended segment for semi-urban entrepreneurs)
Must undertake an economically viable income-generating activity
schemes.maximum_loan_limit: Credit Line 1: up to ₹20.00 Lakh; Credit Line 2: up to ₹30.00 Lakh
schemes.interest_rate: Credit Line 1: 6.0% p.a. for both male & female; Credit Line 2: 8.0% p.a. for male, 6.0% p.a. for female beneficiaries
documents_required: Income certificate issued by competent authority

schemes.scheme_name: Mission Shakti 0% Interest Loan Scheme (Odisha Pilot Window)
schemes.implementing_agency: Mission Shakti Department, Government of Odisha via Scheduled Commercial Banks
criteria: Must be a registered Women Self Help Group (WSHG) in Odisha
Group must have completed at least 6 months of active savings and internal lending
Prompt repayment track record
Directly applicable to peri-urban & rural women in Khordha/Bhubaneswar blocks
schemes.maximum_loan_limit: Up to ₹10.00 Lakh loan with 100% interest subvention (Zero Interest)
schemes.interest_rate: 0.0% effective interest rate (State Govt reimburses the full bank interest up to ₹10 Lakh upon regular repayment)
documents_required: Bank account passbook of the SHG
Aadhaar cards of President and Secretary

schemes.implementing_agency: APICOL & Department of Agriculture & Farmers' Empowerment, Government of Odisha
criteria: Any individual entrepreneur, farmer, or agri-graduate setting up a commercial agro-enterprise in Odisha
Must register on the GO-SUGOM / MKUY portal before commencing project
Greenfield or expansion of commercial dairy, goatry, food processing, cold room, nursery
schemes.maximum_loan_limit: Capital Investment Subsidy (CIS) of 40% of fixed capital (up to ₹50.00 Lakh); 50% subsidy for SC/ST/Women/Agri-graduates
schemes.interest_rate: Bank commercial agriculture loan rate, compensated by direct 40%-50% back-ended capital subsidy
documents_required: Detailed Project Report (DPR) approved by APICOL
Land possession documents (RoR or minimum 10-year registered lease)

schemes.scheme_name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana (Rooftop Solar for Micro-Units)
schemes.implementing_agency: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE) via DISCOMs & National Solar Portal
criteria: Micro-enterprises, dairy farmers, and home-based units operating in premises with a registered electricity consumer connection
Sufficient shadow-free rooftop or shed space
schemes.maximum_loan_limit: Direct Central Government Capital Subsidy: ₹30,000 for 1 kW, ₹60,000 for 2 kW, ₹78,000 for 3 kW and above; Collateral-free bank loan at repo + 0.5% (~7% p.a.)
schemes.interest_rate: ~7.0% p.a. concessional green credit through SBI, PNB, Canara Bank
documents_required: Aadhaar Card and bank account details
Site photograph and roof feasibility report via empaneled solar vendor
